periods.summary: Ikki arrives in Osaka as Hagun's captain and immediately attracts national attention as the F-rank who defeated Raikiri. At the banquet he protects Shizuku from Yui Tatara's poison trap and earns recognition from Yuudai Moroboshi. Moroboshi later invites him to the family okonomiyaki shop so that Ikki will enter their match in peak condition. Ouma confronts Ikki that night, denounces his strength as trickery, and wounds him; Ikki discovers that his body freezes at decisive moments. In the first-round duel against Moroboshi he is repeatedly caught by Moroboshi's tactics and by that unexplained paralysis. Near defeat, he recalls and synchronizes with the movement pattern copied from Edelweiss: instantaneous zero-to-max acceleration. With this awakened sword movement plus Ittou Shura and Shinkirou, he defeats Moroboshi and advances to round two.

key_events.summary: Sees Akatsuki's representatives openly provoke competitors and protects Shizuku from Tatara's poison.
Accepts Moroboshi's invitation to the Moroboshi family restaurant and promises to repay the meal in battle.
Fights Ouma and discovers a freezing symptom tied to the Edelweiss duel.
Defeats the reigning Seven Stars Sword King in a fierce first-round match.

periods.summary: Ikki returns from medical treatment in time to watch Stella finish her B-block battle and concludes her revealed Brute Dragon Roar is not the true fruit of Nene's training. He then confronts Amane Shinomiya, deduces that Amane is not predicting futures but causing wished-for outcomes through overwhelming luck/causality, and firmly rejects Amane's offer to hand him the Seven Stars championship. At night he tries to reconnect with Stella, flees Sara's intrusive demand to paint him nude, and takes refuge in Ouma's room, where he learns Ouma's cooperation with Akatsuki is tied to Itsuki and to drawing out Stella's potential. On the compressed second-round day Ikki reassures Stella, watches Kurando's evolved swordsmanship and Sara's copy of himself with alarm, then begins his match against Byakuya by immediately using Ittou Rasetsu rather than playing into Byakuya's twenty-three-move prediction.

key_events.summary: Deduces Amane's real wish-granting luck power and refuses his championship gift.

periods.summary: Vol-08 frames Ikki through side episodes and an origin story. After defeating Kirihara, he demonstrates sword techniques to classmates and reveals he has memorized 126 sword styles, including Stella's Imperial Arts. His kindness toward classmates and care for Shizuku motivate both Stella's attraction and Shizuku's jealousy. During the poltergeist incident he teams with Kanata, trusts her Diamond Dust support, captures a telekinetic monkey and learns Kanata's noblesse-oblige creed. The final Episode0 reveals his entrance exam: he challenged Yuri Oreki because he knew she was the strongest present, copied and evolved her sword style, endured Violet Pain, used Ittou Shura and a blade-stealing counter, and won admission while refusing to abandon the knight's path despite Oreki's warning.

periods.summary: Ikki opens the volume by defeating former finalist Byakuya in a record 0.8 seconds with Ittou Rasetsu, but privately recognizes the win as costly because it spends his daily trump card before the Sara match. In the infirmary he recovers, jokes with Stella, meets his father Itsuki, and is stunned when Itsuki proposes severing their parent-child relationship for the Kurogane family's order. During the shopping interlude Ikki helps handle Sara's clothing problem, rescues a teleporting infant with Stella and Sara, and hears Sara's history with her father's unfinished painting. Her statement that one-sided love of a parent is still valid gives Ikki the answer he needed: he refuses to cut ties with Itsuki and tells him to remain his father despite their opposing paths. In the third round Ikki faces Sara without Ittou Shura, dismantles her necro battalion with footwork, exposes the limits of her copied Edelweiss, then uses a one-sword first-strike advantage and even his skull as a timing shield to cut the phantom. He finally defeats Sara's true soul-image, Mario Rosso, by luring it into Edelweiss's residual vacuum cuts and stabbing Sara while holding Intetsu in his teeth. He reaches the semifinals, only to witness Shizuku's bloody defeat by Amane on the waiting-room feed.

key_events.summary: Uses Ittou Rasetsu to defeat Byakuya in 0.8 seconds but suffers severe backlash.

periods.summary: Ikki trains overnight by cutting wood and iron with paper to refine Edelweiss-style energy control, preparing for Amane while Stella encourages him. Bakuya Tsukikage reveals Amane's original identity and life story, enabling Ikki to understand the hatred he senses. After Stella defeats Ouma, Ikki visits Shizuku and Alice, thanks Shizuku for fighting, and declares that only Amane cannot beat him. During the semifinal, he refuses to chase Amane if he withdraws, then provokes him by exposing his self-pity. In battle he faces luck-amplified sword strikes and ricocheting Azure blades, but uses clothing to catch the blades and embodied sword mastery to recover from every forced mistake. When Amane stops his heart, Ikki restarts it manually and cuts him down without using Ittou Shura. After Amane's post-defeat rampage, Ikki activates Ittou Shura anyway to save the venue and, more importantly, to give Amane a reason not to abandon himself. He defeats Amane's final self-made sword motion with the second secret sword Rekkou. Although a death result has grazed him, he initially seems fine, then collapses in the preparation room. Kiriko saves him, but he wakes a day late, believing he missed the final; Stella and the committee reveal everyone waited and Kaieda reschedules the final for the following night.

key_events.summary: Learns Amane's past and Tsukikage's request before the semifinal.

Defeats Amane's causality by making his swordsmanship a stronger inevitability.

Wakes late and accepts the rescheduled final against Stella.
